SoundAlarmState.title: Sound Alarm State
SoundAlarmState.description: Represents the state and configuration of the sound alarm system for a specific user.

isArmed.description: Indicates if the alarm system is currently armed.

soundDetected.description: True if the sound sensor has detected a sound event.

alarmDuration.description: Duration in seconds for the buzzer to sound when triggered.

/users/{userId}/soundAlarm/state.description: Singleton document per user to hold the current state and configuration of their sound alarm.
